items.q: he went on to Rheinschagen(?) and the more Classical-versed teachers

ctx.x: How long did he study with you?

Oh, I guess a couple of years or so, and then he went on to Rheinschagen(?) and the more Classical-versed teachers, those who didn't know anything about Jazz. But I gave him an approach to Jazz.
